boundary.curve: Each grip +/- A*(1-cos(pi*t/T))/2 for load, hold A, unload A*(1+cos(pi*(t-T-H)/T))/2, hold0; analytic velocity. y,z fixed on grips only. Original geometry reused; this is newly frozen boundary loading, not the old five-bond kinematic protocol.
boundary.constraint_kinetic: All-node K reported; boundary work = trapezoid(-F_material) dot actual grip displacement + exact prescribed boundary DeltaK. The latter is explicit actuator inertial work; free-node K independently reported.

actual_analytic_expression: ql=ternary(time<T,time/T,1); qu=ternary(time<T+H,0,ternary(time<2*T+H,(time-T-H)/T,1)); u=A/2*(cos(pi*qu)-cos(pi*ql)); v=A*pi/(2*T)*(sin(pi*ql)-sin(pi*qu)); left=-u,-v; right=+u,+v; grip y,z fixed
initial_state: Original body.data, zero velocity, kappa=d=D=0, no restart/import
dynamic_hook: New internal fix LPS/VARIATIONAL/DYNAMIC: POST_INTEGRATE after fix nve/move drift, before Neighbor::decide. Complete failures trigger force_reneighbor at same ntimestep. POST_FORCE converts native density to N before final NVE half kick. setup scales fresh initial forces but never commits.
time_layer: First half kick uses x_n,d_n; drift x_(n+1); irreversible commit at x_(n+1) with U_old-U_new signed loss; pair and bond then use updated topology and d_(n+1); second half kick uses new force. Operator split, generally first-order at changing damage; do not assert second-order fracture accuracy.

contact.energy: Uc=sum over unbonded physical pairs 0.5*(15*kspring*V^2/horizon)*(r-dx)^2 for r<dx; native epair*V independently crosschecked
contact.topology_contact_jump: At d=1 switch, any new contact potential at fixed x is signed separate topology injection; do not hide in damage D.

contact_path_guard: Additional geometric safety guard: stop if active pair reaches r/dx<0.10 (near-coincidence), or relative pair step exceeds inherited 0.10dx. This is a conservative numerical guard, not a calibrated admissible physical overlap. Record maximum penetration without interpreting shallow overlap as a hard-wall violation.
ledger: W_boundary = DeltaU + DeltaK + D_damage + DeltaUc - J_contact_topology + residual. No damping. Signed bond topology energy is -DeltaD, reported separately but not counted twice. Momentum J_external=DeltaP_grip - dt/2*(F_grip_old+F_grip_new).
normalization: running max over [1e-15 J, abs(W), abs(U-U0)+abs(K-K0)+(D-D0)+abs(Uc-Uc0)]; exact prior definition, never reset
external_work: sum over actual steps: -0.5*(F_grip_old+F_grip_new) dot dx_grip + exact DeltaK_grip
D: At identical new x: U(x_new,d_old)-U(x_new,d_new); signed_topology=-D for display only
independent_audit: Every actual step: frozen model U,force,kappa,d,D; native VV equations, momentum, IDs, contact; explicit VV/spatial/switch/contact defect decomposition
save_strategy: Every step scalar CSV, FP64 x/v/physical total and material forces once in compressed trajectory. Sparse changes of d save original ID,kappa,d; all kappa can be reconstructed exactly from x and frozen model and is checked online. Full keyframes at initial/onset/first failure/new record maxDeltaD>=0.08/phase transitions/contact activation/stop or end. Stop also saves previous full state and restart. No duplicated full time-by-all-bond matrices.
stop_handling: First violation stops before another run 1; persist violating state, previous state, event IDs, energy and exact source SHA. No dt/4 continuation. No P4 specimen.
limitations: No natural fracture area/Gc/macroscopic strength certificate
No active dynamic contact PASS unless observed
